item_short_desc: Rothco's MOLLE Folding Solar Panel is the perfect portable charger for your outdoor adventures, whether you're camping, hunting, or hiking. Equipped with 2 MOLLE straps, this solar panel easily attaches to your tactical gear for on-the-go charging. Designed with high-efficiency monocrystalline cells, it ensures maximum sun absorption to keep your devices powered. Compatible with Rothco’s Waterproof Solar Power Bank, it offers a USB 5V output (1.5A) for charging various gadgets.
